summary: CRITICAL: Deliverable is incomplete. Missing config/license-config.json (referenced by workflow) and tests/ directory with Pester tests (required by workflow steps). Code quality of provided files is strong: LicenseChecker.psm1 is well-modularized, Invoke-LicenseCheck.ps1 has excellent error handling, workflow YAML follows best practices (pinned refs, least-privilege permissions). However, task requires TDD (write failing test FIRST); no Pester tests provided. Run-ActTests.ps1 is complex (lines 41–200 with nested loops/assertions) but functional. Without config and test fixtures, workflow will fail immediately: line 47 tries `Invoke-Pester -Path tests/` (dir missing), line 58 tries to read CONFIG_PATH which doesn't exist. Incomplete deliverable.
